ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the length of line segment $AB=23$, $BC=15$, and $M$ is the midpoint of $AC$. What is the length of line segment $CM$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB=23$, $BC=15$,\\
thus $AC=AB-BC=23-15=8$.\\
Also, since $M$ is the midpoint of $AC$,\\
thus $CM=\frac{1}{2}AC=\frac{1}{2}\times 8=\boxed{4}$.
